title.zh: 将邦板牙省瓜瓜市镇普隆马斯莱描笼涯的Natividad国立中学附属校从同市镇Natividad国立中学分离，改设为独立的普隆马斯莱国立中学并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Separating the Natividad National High School Annex in Barangay Pulungmasle, Municipality of Guagua, Province of Pampanga from the Natividad National High School located in Barangay Natividad, Municipality of Guagua, Province of Pampanga and converting the same into an Independent National High School to be known as the Pulungmasle National High School and appropriating funds therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu của Trường Trung học Natividad Quốc gia tại Barangay Pulungmasle, Đô thị Guagua, Tỉnh Pampanga khỏi Trường Trung học Natividad Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Pulungmasle Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขตของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Natividad แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Pulungmasle เทศบาล Guagua จังหวัด Pampanga ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Natividad แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Pulungmasle แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus, Sekolah Menengah Natividad Nasional di Barangay Pulungmasle, Kotamadya Guagua, Provinsi Pampanga dari Sekolah Menengah Natividad Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Pulungmasle Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus, Sekolah Menengah Natividad Kebangsaan di Barangay Pulungmasle, Perbandaran Guagua, Wilayah Pampanga daripada Sekolah Menengah Natividad Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Pulungmasle Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: The Natividad National High School Annex in Barangay Pulungmasle, Municipality of Guagua, Province of Pampanga, is hereby separated from the Natividad National High School located in Barangay Natividad, Municipality of Guagua, Province of Pampanga and the same is converted into an independent national high school to be known as the Pulungmasle National High School.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall take the necessary steps for the immediate implementation of this Act.

The funding requirement for the operation of the Pulungmasle National High School shall be charged to the appropriations for the current fiscal year of the Natividad National High School - Pulungmasle Annex. Thereafter, such amount as may be necessary for the implementation of this Act is hereby authorized to be appropriated in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
